name: Historic Centre of Puebla
description: Puebla's historic centre sits about 100 km east of Mexico City, in the shadow of the Popocatépetl volcano. The city was laid out from scratch in 1531, and its streets still hold a 16th–17th-century cathedral, an old archbishop's palace and many houses clad in colourful glazed tiles. Local builders blended European and American ideas into a distinctive Baroque style found nowhere else.
